correctness.rationale: Addition formula fixes the exact Gram normalization. Antipodal parity yields six compulsory zeros; a matching-graph decomposition in even degrees and signed-root rank-three decomposition in odd degrees yield the stated complete eigenvalue lists. Independent direct 12x12 checks agree for 61 degrees. Python Fractions verify the finite list of degrees 0..19 exhaustively and show the unique positive minimum 65/32768 at degree 10. Bernstein Legendre inequality, pi>3 and sqrt(3)/2>5/6 imply |P_l(1/2)|<1/5, |P_l(0)|<11/60 for every l>=20; every branch then strictly exceeds 1/30 or more, completing all infinite quantifiers. Numerical checking is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The cuboctahedron is the minimal Archimedean octahedrally symmetric orbit and a natural fixed sampling configuration. The result gives all exact-degree output singular values, the sharp degree-3 surjectivity threshold, and an unexpectedly tiny but nonzero degree-ten invariant singular value whose reciprocal controls worst-case least-norm interpolation. The exact 65/32768 constant distinguishes a near-harmonic design from a genuine rank defect and is an exact all-degree operational stability invariant, not merely recomputation of a known graph spectrum.
